# Musme

> Musme builds AI systems, content, and digital products for owner-led businesses, especially in healthcare and restaurants.

- [Musme home](https://www.musme.co/): services, selected work, products, and how a project works
- [Full text version](https://www.musme.co/llms-full.txt): the whole site in one markdown file
- [Test Shift](https://testshift.musme.co/): rent an AI QA team by the hour
- [Citable](https://aeogeo.musme.co/): see which parts of a page AI search crawlers can read
- [PDFDesk](https://pdfdesk.musme.co/): edit PDFs like a Word document

Contact: hello@musme.ai
